description: Assesses overall health and checks for anemia, infection, and clotting issues.
possible_interpretation_notes: Elevated WBC indicates infection; low Hb indicates anemia; low platelets indicate bleeding risk.

description: Measures blood fats to evaluate cardiovascular risk.
possible_interpretation_notes: High LDL/Triglycerides increase heart disease risk; high HDL is protective.

description: Measures liver enzymes, proteins, and bilirubin.
possible_interpretation_notes: Elevated ALT/AST suggests liver irritation; high bilirubin causes jaundice.

description: Evaluates how effectively kidneys filter metabolic waste products.
possible_interpretation_notes: Elevated creatinine or BUN indicates impaired kidney filtration efficiency.

description: Checks functioning of the thyroid gland.
possible_interpretation_notes: High TSH suggests hypothyroidism (underactive); Low TSH suggests hyperthyroidism.
